ConfigureCX8WriteProtect.description: This action supports for PCIe CX-8 in band updates only, and users will need to manually disable #WP before the update and enable #WP after the update is completed.
ConfigureCX8WriteProtect.longDescription: This action supports for PCIe CX-8 in band updates only, and users will need to manually disable #WP before the update and enable #WP after the update is completed.

ConfigureHardwareWriteProtect.description: This action configures hardware write protection for supported components. Users will need to manually disable write protection before firmware updates and enable it after updates are completed.
ConfigureHardwareWriteProtect.longDescription: This action configures hardware write protection for supported components. Users will need to manually disable write protection before firmware updates and enable it after updates are completed.

DellOemUpdateService.description: This is the complex property for the additional OEM Links.
DellOemUpdateService.longDescription: This is the complex property for the additional OEM Links.

enumDescriptions.Default: Apply write protection configuration to all supported hardware components.

enumLongDescriptions.Default: Apply write protection configuration to all supported hardware components. This is the default value and currently the only supported option.

Install.description: This action is used to install firmware inventory instances
Install.longDescription: This action shall perform install of firmware inventory instances

InstallStagedPackages.description: This action creates install jobs for all eligible firmware packages in the LocalImageStore collection. Supports @Redfish.OperationApplyTime (Immediate or OnReset).
InstallStagedPackages.longDescription: This action accepts no package list parameter. Install jobs are created for all packages with PackageValidationStatus = Success in the LocalImageStore collection based on the operation apply time. The action supports @Redfish.OperationApplyTime with values Immediate (install now) or OnReset (install on next reboot).

RecoverFirmware.description: This action shall recover BOSS controller firmware in case of root of trust (RoT) failure.
RecoverFirmware.longDescription: This action shall recover BOSS controller firmware in case of root of trust (RoT) failure.
